display.purpose: Org masthead, login wordmark, portal greeting, box-office amounts. Barlow Condensed, uppercase, semibold.

headline.purpose: Section titles such as Cartelera de hoy. Barlow Condensed, uppercase.

title.purpose: Client names, card titles, default button type. Barlow semibold.

body.purpose: Running copy, form labels, service lines. Barlow regular.

label.purpose: Column heads, pane labels, status chips, listing times. Condensed uppercase with tabular nums.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Listing sheets and default cards, always with a 1px rail.

shadows.name: control
shadows.purpose: Outline buttons, inputs, and selects — a stroke companion, not lift.

motion.name: color-swap
motion.purpose: Hover invert and button fill changes. Colors only; no lift.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 90%, black); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: Vermillion CTA for Nuevo turno, Ingresar, Canjear.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent) 90%, black); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 40%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Paper plate with rail; hover inverts to ink.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--surface-hover); color: var(--surface-hover-foreground); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: No fill at rest; hover inverts like a listing row.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--surface-hover); color: var(--surface-hover-foreground); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Paper field with rail stroke and vermillion focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-field__label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-field__input { height: 36px; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 14px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-field__input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-field__input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Condensed uppercase chip; vermillion means in progress / Now.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 2px; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-chip--now { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-foreground); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Listing Sheet
components.description: White paper plate on lobby with rail and hairline sheet shadow.
components.html:
Resumen del turno

Cliente, servicio y total en una hoja.
components.css: .ds-sheet { background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 2px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(20 24 32 / 0.06); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-sheet__title { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-sheet__body { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted-foreground); }

components.name: Live Listing Row
components.description: Cartelera row; in-progress inverts the whole plate to ink.
components.html: 10:30Gian AnibaldiCorte · Sala 1En curso
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3.5rem minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; font-family: var(--font-sans); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-row--live { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); } .ds-row__time { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-row__name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-row__meta { font-size: 14px; opacity: 0.8; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 2px; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-row--live .ds-chip--now { background: #ffffff; color: var(--destructive); } .ds-row:not(.ds-row--live):hover { background: var(--surface-hover); color: var(--surface-hover-foreground); }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 8px; background: var(--sidebar); color: var(--sidebar-foreground); border-radius: 2px; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-nav__item { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 2px; color: inherit; font-size: 14px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav__item:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); } .ds-nav__item--active { background: var(--sidebar-accent); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav__item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--sidebar-ring); }

narrative.overview:
The product reads like a cinema listing under fluorescent lobby light, not like a SaaS dashboard. The operator scans today’s program as hour, name, service, and room on a white sheet; the live session inverts to ink; box office pits production against cash as opposing panes. Vermillion is reserved for Now and for the action that writes the next turn.

The world is cool, high-key, and slightly industrial: lobby fluorescent behind paper sheets, near-square plates, condensed numerals for time and money. Density is listing density — tight rows, generous section gaps — so the day of the chair is scannable on a phone at the station. Confirmed visual rejections: the previous cream + charcoal + gold + Inter look, generic equal-tile KPI grids, and luxury barbershop tropes.
keyCharacteristics: Fluorescent lobby field with white listing sheets and ink type
Barlow for names and copy; Barlow Condensed for mastheads, hours, money, and column heads
Vermillion only for Now, primary action, focus, and selection
Live row and hover invert to ink on milk
Near-square plates (2px on sheets and controls; 3px CSS radius token)
Hairline rail + 1px ink-tinted sheet shadow; no hard offset blocks

rules.name: The Vermillion Privilege Rule
rules.body: Vermillion marks Now, the one action that advances the day, focus, and selection. It is not a wash, not a left stripe, not a decorative icon tint.

rules.name: The Invert-to-Ink Rule
rules.body: A live session, a hovered listing row, and a highlighted menu item invert the whole surface to ink on milk. Do not signal “active” with a colored bar or a soft badge alone.

rules.name: The Condensed Listing Rule
rules.body: Hours, money, dates, and column heads use Barlow Condensed with tabular numbers. Names and sentences stay in Barlow. Do not add a third family.

rules.name: The Masthead Speaks Rule
rules.body: The page title is Condensed, semibold, uppercase. It does not sit under a kicker or eyebrow; the heading carries its own weight.

rules.name: The Cartelera Rule
rules.body: Today’s program is a divided listing (time | name | service | room), not a grid of equal metric tiles. Box office is one opposing strip under the listing, not four hero numbers.

rules.name: The Sheet Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces are flat paper on lobby. No hard offset block shadows, no glass, no colored halo. Invert or change fill for state; do not raise the plate.

rules.name: The Plate Rule
rules.body: If it is a sheet, a row, a button, or a chip, it is a 2–3px plate. Soft 12px cards and pill chrome belong to the discarded Inter/shadcn look.

dos: Do set the canvas to lobby and put content on paper sheets with a 1px rail.
Do set live and hover rows to full ink invert, not a tint or a side stripe.
Do put the day’s action on the vermillion accent button (Nuevo turno, Ingresar).
Do set hours, money, and column heads in Barlow Condensed with tabular numbers.
Do keep mastheads Condensed, semibold, uppercase, with the date or caption in listing type beside or below — not as a kicker above.
Do theme selection, caret, and focus from vermillion; scrollbars from steel on wash.
donts: Don't rebuild a page as four equal metric tiles (the discarded Resumen).
Don't use cream, gold, Inter, or soft 12px shadcn cards — that identity is retired.
Don't wash a screen in vermillion or use it as a left/right accent bar.
Don't add a kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't use hard offset block shadows or glass/blur decoration.
Don't introduce a third type family or monospace as a “technical” costume.
Don't treat `.dark` as the product world; the lobby is fluorescent and light.
